items.title: Executive Inbox Management & Email Workflow Optimization
items.description:
This client was struggling with an overcrowded inbox, missed follow-ups, and difficulty identifying priority emails. I stepped in, reorganized and categorized 600+ emails, implemented filters, labels, priority rules, and a follow-up system, and cleared outdated messages. 
The outcome? A 95% reduction in inbox clutter, faster identification of priority emails, and a more structured workflow for managing daily communications.

items.title: Project Coordination System
items.description: A practice project showing how tasks, owners, deadlines, statuses and supporting information can be structured into a clear project workflow.

items.title: Expense & Reporting Dashboard
items.description: The business needed a reliable way to monitor monthly business expenses and identify where the most money was being spent. Using Google Sheets, i tracked and categorized 20 transactions across 8 expense categories, then created a pie chart to visually highlight the highest-spending category. I compiled the analysis into a structured Microsoft Word report, giving the client a clear overview of monthly spending and supporting better expense monitoring and financial decision-making.
